caption: Uffizi Gallery courtyard, Florence
composition: Long Vasari courtyard with colonnades looking toward the Arno · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the piazza end the camera looks straight down the long Uffizi courtyard. Vasari's arcaded colonnades run on both sides with statues in the niches, and at the far end the central arch opens onto the Arno with the hills beyond. The 12:02 midday light is bright under a clear blue sky.
